messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing customer pages not being ACKed. incident-bot shows 'delivered' but oncall never got phone/SMS. Vendor webhooks return 200. Impact: some high-priority alerts not acknowledged. :eyes:
kevin: looking... are these from the new notify-adapter rollout?
maria: yes, started ~12:10 UTC. sample message id 1693245980 shows delivered=true but no ack callback.
ops-bot: [automated] incident-bot: attempt=1 destination=pager_vendor status=200 msg_id=abc123 ack_id= null
jun: quick scan of adapter logs — ack_id field empty on the webhook response. vendor callback handler is not seeing X-Ack header. here's a quick repro I ran: ```curl -v -X POST https://pager.vendor/webhook -d '{"page":"test"}' -H 'X-Sign: abc'``` response: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
  Content-Length: 2
  Date: ...
body: OK 
(no X-Ack header)
kevin: if vendor isn't sending ack callbacks, our handler marks as delivered and doesn't trigger fallback escalation. not good.
sara: i've pinged vendor eng on their slack thread. meanwhile, can we flip notify-orch to require explicit ack within 30s else escalate to manual-sms?
maria: i'm on it. patching temporary routing rule: escalate_on_no_ack=30s for prod-high.
maria: /deploy notify-orch-config prod set escalate_on_no_ack=30s -> success
ops-bot: [deploy] notify-orch-config updated by maria at 1693246232
oncall-sre: confirming — i'm getting manual SMS fallback pages now. customers should be reachable again. :thumbsup:
pagerflow-bot: alert: vendor-callback-missing-ack detected. samples=34 window=12m
jun: vendor response: they rolled out a batching optimization that accidentally dropped X-Ack header for batch callbacks. rollback started.
kevin: keep automation disabled for 45m to watch for any flapping. maria, can you create an incident record with timeline/impact?
maria: creating now. TL;DR: root cause vendor removed ack header in batch mode; symptom our adapter treated pages as delivered causing no escalation; mitigations: turned on ack-timeout escalation rule + manual-sms fallback; vendor rollback in progress. tagging @oncall-sre for postmortem.
sara: i'll compile affected customer list (acct ids) and attach to incident doc.
maria: vendor rollback finished — monitoring for 10m.
oncall-sre: running tests — ack callbacks now present and my test pages got normal ack flows. all clear from oncall side.
maria: reverting temporary routing change. /deploy notify-orch-config prod set escalate_on_no_ack=0 -> success
kevin: in postmortem please include the exact webhook request/response pairs and the log lines where ack_id==null. also propose a test that fails the build if the vendor callback schema lacks X-Ack.
maria: will add logs + test proposal to the incident doc. thanks everyone. :heart:
ops-bot: [automated] thread closed at 1693246425
